programs.title: My Market Kitchen
programs.desc: Laura is with Chef Terry who cooks up Stir-fried Pipis with Chilli Jam. Toby Puttock is with Chef Leslie Chan, and he cooks up a very exotic Shanghainese Smoked Fish.

programs.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programs.desc: Bread is a pillar of the Italian cuisine, but beans are the base in many of the Italian regions too. Lidia makes crostini two ways, monkfish brodetto with cannellini, and talks about garlic bread.

programs.title: Tom Kerridge's Pub Kitchen Secrets
programs.desc: Ingredients take centre stage as Tom reveals one of the more unusual dishes on his pub menu: a luxurious oyster mushroom risotto without any rice.

programs.title: Silvia's Italian Masterclass
programs.desc: Silvia walks you through the classic, crowd pleasing recipes of your favourite Italian breads. All you need now is a little olive oil, balsamic and salt and you have yourself the perfect appetiser.

programs.title: Food Safari
programs.desc: Food Safari's African episode is filled with delicious recipes from some great chefs and home-cooks and ingredients that are now available in Australia.

programs.title: The Chocolate Queen
programs.desc: This episode is packed with irresistible treats! Kirsten unveils the secrets to a perfect sponge cake and whips up baked apples, buttery fudge shortbreads and creamy maritozzi buns.
